title: ADAM: A DIVERSE ARCHIVE OF MANKIND FOR EVALUATING AND ENHANCING LLMS IN BIOGRAPHICAL REASONING

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model accuracy on biographical reasoning tasks stratified by the subject's popularity level (high, medium, low) based on Wikipedia engagement metrics to measure performance disparities between well-known and lesser-known individuals.
Comparing model factual accuracy and performance on biographical questions prompted in English versus the subject's native language to measure English-centric disparities.
